display_name: Pipi Labu Baby Customer Cast v1
purpose: A small, differentiated baby customer cast study that improves queue life and role readability without changing the canonical customer rig or gameplay loop.

source_truth.reuse_rule: Use this base face/material/rig language for future variants; do not edit or overwrite the referenced candidate in this ticket.

accepted: small customer bodies with a strong size contrast against the oversized owner
fruit and apple receipt as the highest-salience social event
soft rendered caramel/cream urajiro, low eyes, compact muzzle, matte fur, glossy eyes and nose
anthropomorphic queue roles that can be understood at a glance
gray-board character-sheet clarity as presentation structure only
contextual: low four-legged baby-loaf anatomy from the supplied clips
motion cues that explain eagerness without becoming UI decoration
Ruby/Honeygold color accents as order/receipt context, never as a new gameplay rule
rejected: new player avatar or owner identity
role variation that changes collision, queue membership, patience timing, or service authority
generic mascot-card grid, pasted video pixels, watermark, logo, or social UI

shared_silhouette_contract.crown: uninterrupted circular head/crown from front and three-quarter views
shared_silhouette_contract.ear_policy: tiny lateral fur-set hints swallowed by the contour; no geometry may rise above the crown
shared_silhouette_contract.face: low dark oval eyes, compact black nose, cream lower muzzle, small curved mouth
shared_silhouette_contract.coat: caramel crown/back with soft cream urajiro lower cheeks, muzzle, belly, and paws
shared_silhouette_contract.mobile_read_rule: At queue distance, each role must read as the same Pipi Labu baby family before its expression detail is read.

roles.queue_read: curious newcomer asking for the first Ruby apple
roles.gaze: front with a slight leftward pull toward the fruit source
roles.eye_treatment: open low ovals with clear paired catchlights
roles.paw_pose: left paw lifted in a small asking gesture; right paw grounded
roles.apple_state: no apple held; Ruby marker is a small authored accent only
roles.silhouette_delta: slightly smaller body and larger head preserve baby-newcomer vulnerability
roles.review_hypothesis: A compact asking pose makes the order readable before the player reaches the customer.

roles.queue_read: served customer visibly holding the Honeygold apple
roles.eye_treatment: relaxed smiling eyes with warm catchlights
roles.paw_pose: both paws close around the apple at chest height
roles.silhouette_delta: slightly rounder torso gives the hold pose a stable cradle
roles.review_hypothesis: The hold pose should make receipt and possession legible without stealing the handoff peak.

roles.queue_read: quiet customer waiting without becoming visually inert
roles.paw_pose: paws tucked close under the muzzle; low loaf stance
roles.silhouette_delta: wider, lower torso and tucked paws create a grounded loaf contrast
roles.review_hypothesis: A quieter grounded role can diversify the line without adding top-heavy or noisy detail.

roles.queue_read: eager regular leaning into the next handoff
roles.gaze: front, fixed on the service point
roles.eye_treatment: slightly wider ovals with clear catchlights
roles.paw_pose: one paw lifted and one paw braced; short forward lean
roles.silhouette_delta: slightly taller stance and forward lean imply motion without changing the base rig
roles.review_hypothesis: One restrained eager pose can create queue energy while leaving the ready customer and apple as the focal event.

review_artifact.background: warm neutral gray board with restrained cream/amber annotation
review_artifact.source: deterministic Pillow drawing from this contract; no external image pixels

future_integration_gate.precondition: The open v0.9.3 service-loop gate is recorded or explicitly deferred; this cast sheet cannot count as gameplay evidence.
visual_review: Leo and Jon compare the four roles at the generated board scale and at a mobile-sized thumbnail.
Reject any role whose ears read above the circular crown, whose coat breaks the existing material hierarchy, or whose pose competes with the apple contact.
Record whether each role is identifiable in one second at queue distance and whether the line feels varied rather than noisy.
future_integration_gate.sandbox_import: If the board survives visual review, generate one bounded role variant from the existing side-ear v4 base into a disposable local 0/0 sandbox. Keep the existing v4 FBX, maps, six actions, attachments, and collision marker as source truth until the variant passes technical checks.
private_play_test: List Studio instances and assert the exact PlaceId/GameId inside the bounded mutation.
Keep queue membership, prompt rules, patience, order data, handoff timing, rewards, and audio selection unchanged.
Review one complete ten-customer shift on mobile and desktop camera distances: role recognition, ready-customer targeting, apple receipt/hold, collision readability, and line direction.
Remove the candidate root if any role slows targeting, hides the apple, creates collision ambiguity, or makes customers feel like a generic crowd.
future_integration_gate.promotion: Only a later explicit Leo/Jon visual decision followed by sandbox and exact-private-place validation may mark a role approved; no automatic promotion, upload, publish, or canonical replacement is implied.
